specs.title: Login with a wrong password fails and with the correct password opens the shop

steps.title: Precondition: create a customer account, nobody is logged in
1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the wrong password
3. Open the account menu
4. Close the menu and log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu

specs.title: Add a product to an empty basket from the product list

steps.title: 1. Open the product list
2. Add the product to the basket
3. Open the basket with the button `Your Basket`
4. Read the total of the basket

specs.title: Change the quantity of a product and remove it from the basket

steps.title: Precondition: a logged-in customer with product A and product B in the basket
1. Open the basket
2. Click the plus button of product A
3. Click the minus button of product A
4. Click the minus button of product A again
5. Click the trash button of product A

specs.title: A basket holds no more items of a product than its purchase limit

steps.title: 1. Add the product to the basket from the product list
2. Open the basket and click plus until the quantity is 5
3. Click the plus button one more time
4. Read the basket
5. Add the product to the basket from the product list again

specs.title: Pay an order with the wallet only when the balance covers the total

steps.title: Precondition: a logged-in customer with a saved address, a saved card, a basket and a wallet balance
1. Open the basket, click `Checkout`, select the saved address and continue
2. Select `Standard Delivery` and continue
3. Read the wallet button `Pay`
4. Open `Orders & Payment` → `Order History` from the account menu
5. Open `Orders & Payment` → `Digital Wallet` from the account menu
Precondition: add money to the wallet with the saved card up to the order total
6. Go through the checkout again with `Standard Delivery`
7. Click the wallet button `Pay`
8. Click `Place your order and pay`
9. Open `Orders & Payment` → `Digital Wallet` from the account menu
10. Open `Orders & Payment` → `Order History` from the account menu
